blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Supreme Court Associate Justice Japar Dimaampao, one of five candidates vying to succeed Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo, vowed to pursue equal access to justice and a more humane judiciary during his public interview before the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC). Dimaampao, the second Muslim appointed to the SC, said that his candidacy rests on a commitment to equal justice that transcends personal identity and religious faith. “My being the first Muslim to serve as chief justice is a milestone, but I hope that this legacy will go beyond my identity,” Dimaampao told the panel. “I want to show […]...
